summary:
[TO JOE HALDEMAN1  


Please do not drop my name from the roster of the faithful. I was going to mail you the bread ($12.50) but I got double pneumonia and became ill because of that. Also, my cat was run over and the rent monster ripped off all my money that the food and clothing monster did not. In addition I don’t feel well. 

To be serious, I’m sorry to be late in payment. I really have been out of it with pneumonia—too sick even to call the doctor and too broke to pay him. But here is a check for $12.50, and please reinstate my name. Or is it All Over for me now? 

I tried to pay Norman Spinrad my dues at the DA. Worldcon but he stared at me and mumbled, “Shit on those mickey mouse things; who do you think cares?” And lurched off with his hand inside a chick’s blouse. That sort of dis­ couraged me and I returned to Fullerton to think it all over—and ultimately to get ill with pneumonia. 

As regards credentials, I guess I haven’t informed SFWA of my successes to date either. So I have had my secretary cut out the form and tape it to this sheet. I have filled it out in my own hand. 

The $12.50 I had at the L.A. Worldcon for Norman I eventually spent for a little Christmas tree for myself and my chick, about two feet high with one ornament on a lower branch that the cat ate just before he got run over.
